newsitem.title: USA: Enova urges FERC to reject merger protests.
newsitem.headline: Enova urges FERC to reject merger protests.

text.p: Enova Corp units San Diego Gas & Electric Co and Enova Energy urged the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) this week to reject arguments filed by intervenors seeking to block its planned merger with Pacific Enterprises.
A similar filing was made last week by Southern California Gas Co, the main subisidiary of Pacific Enterprises.
Neighboring Southern California Edison Co had complained to FERC about the gas utility's control of interstate natural gas pipelines.
Other intervenors have expressed concerns about affiliate transactions.
But Enova said the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) will continue to regulate transactions between utilities and their unregulated affiliates.
The CPUC last week opened a proceeding to develop uniform standards of conduct for electric and natural gas utilities and their marketing affiliates.

The two companies are still seeking a disclaimer from FERC review of the merger, but also filed a merger application in January in order to save time if the federal commission decides to invoke jurisdiction.
